name: SemperVirens Venture Capital
identity_check: Confirmed via the March 2025 PRWeb release and Pulse 2.0: SemperVirens Venture Capital (sempervirensvc.com) closed $177M across Core Fund III and Growth Opportunity Fund II; portfolio includes Midi Health and Stepful. The firm's own site (sempervirens.com) failed to load (TLS error), so website is taken from search listings only. Not Sempervirens Fund (Save the Redwoods) or other similarly named entities.
